title: Grateful Dead Live at The Music Box on 1969-04-15

ai_review.summary: Good matrix recording with clear, perfect‑sounding vocals and an intense Dew performance
ai_review.review: The reviewer praises this source as the definitive one, noting that the vocals come through perfectly even though the overall sound quality isn’t flawless. The “Dew” is described as intense, making the recording a solid choice despite minor sonic imperfections.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review (4‑star) that focuses on vocal clarity and overall intensity; limited data prevents high confidence, but the positive tone suggests a solid rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Vocals are clear and perfect; overall sound not pristine but still enjoyable. No major dropouts mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No specific comments on set structure; reviewer emphasizes overall intensity rather than individual songs.
